paragraphs: Issi bar Hini, Shabbat 147a; R' Levi bar Hini (Hina), Jerusalem Talmud Terumot, chapter 4, halakhah 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hina is the parenthetical variant of Hini.

The whole Davidson Shabbat 147a paragraph writes Assi bar Hini where Hyman supplies Issi. All three whole Guggenheimer Terumot 4:2 paragraphs were read and do not name Levi bar Hini there. That is a bounded nonmatch, not absence elsewhere or a locator repair; the second personal title is rendered R'. The Hini/Hina variant and both independent pointers remain without a common-father binding.
